title: europe adds 88 gw wind capacity first half windeurope says 2026 09 01
text:
Sept 1 (Reuters) - Europe added nearly a third more wind energy capacity in ​the first of 2026 than during ‌the same period last year, driven by installations in Germany and increasing offshore connections, industry ​group WindEurope said on Tuesday.
Wind capacity ​in Europe has doubled over the past ⁠decade as governments expanded renewable energy ​generation. Last year, wind and solar produced ​more electricity in the European Union than fossil fuels for the first time.
